topic: Design of a custom Claude-app-style mobile client for the pi coding agent driven by pi --mode rpc (JSONL protocol) exposed through a relay (Tailscale Serve or WebSocket bridge) to a mobile web app/PWA, with Claude-app UX parity: session list, chat bubbles, streaming, tool activity, approvals, push notifications.

focus: Map Pi's RPC lifecycle and define the minimum relay/process architecture
noveltyJustification: 6 of 6 findings were fully new in an empty lineage.
keyQuestions: What process, relay, and client architecture preserves Pi RPC semantics while tolerating mobile disconnects?
answeredQuestions: What process, relay, and client architecture preserves Pi RPC semantics while tolerating mobile disconnects? (MVP architecture)
ruledOut: direct browser-to-Pi stdio
one-shot Pi process per prompt
treating prompt acceptance as run completion
using the transient RPC event stream as the durable session catalog

focus: Map every RPC command and event to a concrete mobile UI surface with Claude-app parity baseline
noveltyJustification: 5 of 6 findings fully new; finding 6 partially overlaps the Remote Control parity theme from finding 5.
keyQuestions: Which Pi RPC commands and events map to session lists, streaming chat, tool activity, and approvals?
answeredQuestions: Which Pi RPC commands and events map to session lists, streaming chat, tool activity, and approvals?
ruledOut: surfacing TUI-only commands in the mobile menu
treating tool_execution_start as an approval request
copying Claude Remote Control permission-mode model verbatim

focus: Design the disconnect-safe state model, replay/reconciliation protocol, and approval epoch semantics
noveltyJustification: 5 of 6 findings fully new; finding 1 partially anticipated by iteration 1 finding 6 sequencing note.
keyQuestions: What state model and reconnection protocol prevent duplicated prompts, lost deltas, or stale approvals?
answeredQuestions: What state model and reconnection protocol prevent duplicated prompts, lost deltas, or stale approvals?
ruledOut: wall-clock replay cursors
auto-resending in-flight prompts after Pi-child crash
client-side approval timeout tracking
broker-side dedup alone

focus: Security and network exposure: Tailscale Serve vs Funnel vs WebSocket bridge, relay authN/authZ, containment, audit
noveltyJustification: 6 of 7 findings fully new; finding 3 extends iteration-2/3 approval and ledger rules to the security plane.
keyQuestions: Which security and network exposure model is safe for a coding agent with workspace tool authority?
answeredQuestions: Which security and network exposure model is safe for a coding agent with workspace tool authority?
ruledOut: Tailscale Funnel as the exposure path
tailnet identity as sole authorization
direct public WebSocket bridge as the default
storing full mutation payloads indefinitely

focus: PWA notifications, background limits, offline mode, and phased product plan
noveltyJustification: 5 of 6 findings fully new; finding 5 re-applies iteration 3 ledger semantics to the PWA lifecycle by design.
keyQuestions: How should PWA notifications, background limits, and Claude-style mobile UX be implemented and phased?
answeredQuestions: How should PWA notifications, background limits, and Claude-style mobile UX be implemented and phased?
ruledOut: silent pushes or background compute on iOS
relying on Background Sync for delivery
client cache as canonical state
decision-carrying push payloads

focus: Independent validation: contradiction pass, residual risks, executable acceptance matrix
noveltyJustification: 3 findings fully new, 2 partially new, 1 re-verification; validation of an accumulated lineage naturally yields lower novelty.
keyQuestions: Independent validation of the accumulated architecture
answeredQuestions: Independent validation of the accumulated architecture
ruledOut: treating switch_session/fork/clone as unconditional transitions
